name: run_all.py
mathematical_scope: Runs dynamically loaded eight new tests and a historical run_all.py subprocess.
input_and_guard_coverage: New test success/count enforced only by assert, which disappears with Python optimization. Historical expected count is never parsed or checked. Bare bootstrap identity and unbounded subprocess runtime.
costs: Includes repeated exact symbolic construction and prior test suite; no timeout and no memory budget.
test_evidence: Eight new test definitions exist in the reviewed test file. 64 inherited and 72 total are printed literals, not observed counts.
acceptance_boundary: Normal-mode successful run requires 8 passing new tests plus prior process exit zero; optimized mode can print success after new test failures.
findings: L12 is security/acceptance-relevant assert misuse: replace with explicit failure. L16 64/64 prior is not derived. RUN_ALL.md additionally says both coefficient exports are checked, but the suite never reads exact_nonzero_resultants.json.
